summary: Backend-only testing for the new video categories feature. All 13 test cases from the review request passed (12 pytest functions, admin login used as a fixture). Verified /api/video-categories returns 7 categories (correct names, slugs and counts), create/update media accepts up to 2 video_categories, filtering via ?video_category works, counts increment correctly, and validation (>2 items or invalid name) returns 400 with the expected Italian message on both POST and PUT. Cleanup DELETE confirmed and GET after delete returns 404. No backend code changes required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2400 lines — consider splitting into modules (media, auth, admin, i18n) in a future iteration; not blocking.
create_media: `doc = {'id': ..., **inp.dict(), ...}` — inp.dict() unconditionally includes video_categories=None for meditations; harmless but consider exclude_none for cleaner stored docs.

list_video_categories aggregation matches on `video_categories: {$exists: True, $ne: None}` and then $unwind — works, but an empty [] would silently unwind to nothing, which is the desired behaviour. No fix needed.
